Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The parent remains incomplete. Closed children record bounded HDF5, transaction, native conformance and FIR readback work, but current main still advertises development-1 and has no HDF5 estimate implementation in modules. Child closure is not proof of current-main adoption. Consolidation passed fitEstimates 16/12 and group 75/74; those counts do not qualify stable interchange.

Fresh context: Yes: integration / acceptance audit.

Next action: Reconcile the closed child source with current main, recover only missing qualified slices, then finish canonical schema/metadata authority, independent fixture coverage, exporter replacement and consumer acceptance. Keep native HDF5 qualification separate from NIfTI and PLS Neuro reuse.

Evidence: docs/estimate-sets.md; docs/plans/estimate-set-implementation.md; closed children and FIR note 2026-10-01; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.
